description: tuicr-wrapper-herdr.sh builds a bash-syntax completion-sentinel command and hands it to 'herdr pane run', which injects it into the pane's interactive shell. Under fish this fails: fish has no $? and no VAR=value assignment. Wrap the payload in 'bash -c' so the pane shell only sees a quoted argument. Local overlay over pkgs.toolbox.tuicr-skills pending upstream PR to agavra/tuicr.
title: Patch tuicr herdr wrapper for non-bash interactive shells
